title: ModelExplanation
description: Wire shape of `explanation` for `bregctl explain model`. Nested compiled-model trees (entities, package, manifestProjection, physicalNames) are declared opaque because bregctl serializes them by passing a compiled-model value straight to serde, so their shape can change without any corresponding line changing in bregctl.

entities.description: Compiled entity table, keyed by entity id. Passthrough of the compiled model; shape follows CompiledEntity and is outside this contract version.
entities.x-registry-passthrough: bregctl writes the compiled entity table as the engine holds it; its shape follows CompiledEntity and is outside this contract version.

physicalNames.description: Compiled physical-name mapping. Passthrough of the compiled model; shape follows the runtime's physical-name projection and is outside this contract version.
physicalNames.x-registry-passthrough: bregctl writes the runtime's physical-name projection as it stands; its shape and is outside this contract version.

package.description: Compiled package identity, or null when the project declares no package. Passthrough of the compiled model; shape follows the runtime's package projection and is outside this contract version.
package.x-registry-passthrough: bregctl writes the runtime's package projection as it stands; its shape and is outside this contract version.

manifestProjection.description: Registry Manifest projection of this registry, or null when the project declares none. Passthrough of the compiled model; shape follows the runtime's manifest projection and is outside this contract version.
manifestProjection.x-registry-passthrough: bregctl writes the runtime's Registry Manifest projection as it stands; its shape and is outside this contract version.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.
